widgets_values: 15-second spec ad for NOVARA, a Milan espresso brand. Early morning in a small Milan cafe. The barista pulls an espresso shot. She hands a white paper cup printed with the black NOVARA logo to a young customer in a camel coat. The customer takes a first sip and smiles, then walks out into the sunny city street holding the cup.

nodes.title: Note: 0 · Models and references

widgets_values: Shot Planner (Gemini) writes 4 shots from the brief. Shot 1 is rendered with Juggernaut XL. Shots 2-4 are each edited from the previous shot with Qwen Image Edit + the next-scene LoRA ('Next Scene: ...'), so the barista, the customer and the NOVARA cup stay the same. Shot Join makes one list of 4 keyframes.
nodes.title: Note: 1 · Shot list and consistent keyframes

widgets_values:
Shot Critic sends every shot to a vision LLM (Gemini Flash Lite by default, 3 independent reviews, majority vote) with the shot list and your brand rules. Each shot gets a score and a route: pass, detail (local fix), consistency (edit against another shot) or reroll. The contact sheet shows the verdicts.
API keys: set them as environment variables before starting ComfyUI, never in the workflow. GEMINI_API_KEY (or GOOGLE_API_KEY), ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.
Slow or 503 errors: Gemini is busy; the critic falls back from Flash Lite to Flash by itself.
nodes.title: Note: 2 · Shot Critic

widgets_values:
Shot Select picks only the shots the critic routed to 'detail' (a wrong logo, garbled text). SAM 3 finds the logo / text, Detail Fixer crops it, and Qwen Image Edit repaints it from your logo reference in 4 steps (Lightning LoRA). The crop is pasted back with a feathered mask, and Shot Reroll Merge (route = detail) puts the fixed shots in place.
When no shot needs a detail fix, this whole group is skipped (lazy input): it costs nothing.
nodes.title: Note: 3 · Detail fix on flagged shots

widgets_values: A second Shot Critic reviews the fixed shots. Shot Keep Better keeps a fix only if it scores at least as well as the original (never make it worse), and saves the approved keyframes.
nodes.title: Note: 4 · Review again, keep only improvements

widgets_values: The approved keyframes become a timed animatic with camera moves from the shot list (MP4).
nodes.title: Note: 5 · Animatic
